name: Omarchy Super Switcher
author: jfdnet
description: All-in-one switching for Omarchy: fast Alt+Tab (Orbit) with maximized landing, workspace numbers on the bar, live workspace overview (Super+Tab), and a gesture-driven Workspace Gallery (Super+A) with click-to-focus and drag-and-drop.

barWidget.description: Workspace buttons, live overview, and visual window switching.
